Laga bilaabo $mg+N=mv^2/R$, $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. Isticmaalka dhererka $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ oo keliya waxay iska indho tirtaa tamarta kinetic-ka (doodda 1); $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ waxay iska indho tirtaa cuf-jiidadka (doodda 2); $90\,\mathrm{N}$ waa khalad calaamad oo ku daraya cuf-jiidadka (doodda 3).
